visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young adults, a male with light-colored hair and glasses and a female with a brown hair bun and glasses, stand side-by-side in front of a dark brown wooden door. They are both holding multiple Harry Potter movie posters in their hands, smiling and talking directly to the camera in a bright indoor setting. (2) From a back-view perspective, the two individuals are seen quickly attaching the various posters to the wooden door in a time-lapse sequence. A large white analog clock graphic with rapidly spinning black hands is centered on the screen, indicating the passage of time. (3) The camera pans slowly across the completed door, which is now entirely covered in organized rows of Harry Potter movie posters from different films in the series. Small white sparkle animations are overlaid on the posters to emphasize the finished result, and the lighting is bright and even.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male and female voice speak in a high-energy, synchronized greeting. The tone is cheerful and bright, with high pitch variability. No background music is present during the initial speech. (2) A rhythmic, percussive ticking sound resembling a clock occurs repeatedly. This SFX is isolated and crisp. (3) The male and female voices begin humming and vocalizing the iconic melody of the Harry Potter theme song (Hedwig's Theme) in a theatrical, exaggerated minor key. The humming is rhythmic and follows the tempo of the visual transitions. There are no actual instruments, only the layered vocal performance of the theme.
